⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** This post is the seat, **`repo:objectstack` seat 4** (the whole-repo lane). Only what another account must read lives here; posture, ledger and round reports live in the project.
- Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` and `references/area-lease.md` (⛔ not copied here).

## Current PM — 🟢 os-justin

- **Seated:** `os-justin` · `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ` · 2026-11-24T01:32Z, on the maintainer's summons in the session: 「开一个 objectstack 座位 ，处理 p1 任务」. The previous holder's clock-out brief (body revision of 2026-11-22, `os-project-manager` · `session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv`) was the newest event on this post; no comment followed it.
- **Intake:** every open `priority:p0` and `priority:p1` card in this repo except `area:cloud` and `area:ux`, by the maintainer's words in the seat session: 「area:cloud area:ui 你不接，其他 p0 p1 都归你」, corrected in the next message to 「area:ux」 (recorded 2026-11-24T03:52Z). **Plus** the `area:ux` Studio redesign epic #36890 (its remaining child cards), taken by zone **a4-S** once seat 3's in-hand Studio cards merge — the maintainer in this seat's session, verbatim: 「是的， studio 专题后续有你的新专区接手」 (recorded 2026-11-24T14:11Z), confirming the hand-off seat 3 posted on mailbox #36810 (7133909231; full hand-off on #36890, 7133810009). Other `area:ux` cards stay outside this seat. Cards another seat holds (assignee + `Claim:`) stay with that seat; security advisories stay with the security lane.
- **Mailbox:** PR #36810. **Patrol:** none — the self-bound patrol routine could not be created in this session (permission refused); wakes come from PR subscriptions (mailbox and in-flight PRs).
- Seat-session tier: the session's default tier, effort as launched (not re-measured at seating).
